Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_TB_ID
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 vcount_tbid number;
begin
 vcount_tbid := 0;
 select count(*) into vcount_tbid from test_voids where
 tb_id = :s_tb_id and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if vcount_tbid = 0 then
 show_error('1603');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
/* exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1603');
 check_package_failure;*/
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;

begin
 
 if :s_test_id = 'ABORH' then
 select decode(:s_test_id,'ABORH',decode(nvl(:result_status_1,'**'),
 '06','A NEG ',
 '00','DISCRP',
 '17','B NEG ',
 '28','AB NEG',
 '51','O POS ',
 '62','A POS ',
 '73','B POS ',
 '84','AB POS',
 '95','O NEG ',:result_status_1))
 into :decode_result_status from dual;
 else
 :decode_result_status := :result_status_1;
 end if;
 :chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:unit_id,null,null);
 --
 if :TEST_VOIDS.RESULT_DATS is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:TEST_VOIDS.RESULT_DATS,v_local_time);
 :TEST_VOIDS.RESULT_DATS := v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if; 
 --
 if :TEST_VOIDS.VOID_DATS is not null then
 v_local_time := null;
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:TEST_VOIDS.VOID_DATS,v_local_time);
 :TEST_VOIDS.VOID_DATS := v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- 
end;
